preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwner/confirmOwner flow)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create new tokens for your address, increasing your token balance arbitrarily. Optionally, use freezeTransfers() to prevent other users from transferring tokens while you execute the attack, then unfreezeTransfers() afterwards.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The LineAxis contract has a mint() function with onlyOwner modifier, allowing the owner to arbitrarily create new tokens. The ownership transfer mechanism (transferOwner/confirmOwner) can be exploited if we can impersonate the current owner to initiate the transfer, then confirm it to become the new owner.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate current owner to call transferOwner(attacker). 2. Call confirmOwner() as attacker to become new owner. 3. Use mint() function to create tokens for attacker address. 4. Optionally freeze/unfreeze transfers to prevent interference.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get current owner address via owner() function. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate owner. 3. Call transferOwner(attacker). 4. Call confirmOwner() as attacker. 5. Verify we're now owner. 6. Call mint(attacker, 1_000_000 * 1e18). 7. Check balance increase.
